Ely Baker Foundation Professor Diane Doerge Wilson Professor of Business Administration, Emerita Baker Foundation Professor Diane Doerge Wilson Professor of Business Administration, Emerita Read more Robin Ely is the Diane Doerge Wilson Professor of Business Administration at Harvard Business School. She conducts research on race and gender relations in organizations with a focus on leadership, identity, and organizational culture change.
